sourced_topology.shared_ps_ac_bracket: Ford names separate attachments to cylinder block and cylinder head.
sourced_topology.alternator_bracket: Ford distinguishes bottom attachment from other engine attachments and identifies alternator pivot fastener separately.

construction_study.fasteners: Three PS, four A/C, two alternator and four engine fasteners: all counts except Ford's two alternator mounting bolts are study assumptions.
construction_study.engine_blind_boss: R12 mm boss X349..373; R5.2 mm smooth thread-envelope bore X357..373; bolt tip X359 gives 14 mm engagement and 2 mm blind-end clearance. Geometry is assumed and closed to internal galleries.
construction_study.head_adapter_frame: Local cylinder-head shape, installed Z255.5. Coil-bracket bosses at engine X-95/-20 are remote from these X349..373 front attachment bosses.

limits: No verified factory bracket part number, casting dimensions, web/rib contours, hole coordinates or bolt grades.
Open ring-and-web geometry explains load paths; it is not a production or fabrication drawing.
Smooth engagement envelopes omit actual threads, torque/preload, contact mechanics, thermal growth and belt-load deflection.
Tensioner and Thermactor supports are not silently assigned to these brackets.
All accessory stations and mounting interfaces remain provisional.
